name: GitHub identity and event queue
description: App authentication, collaborator permissions, delivery deduplication and durable queueing.

name: Claim and inspect PR state
nodeNames: Head still current and PR open
description: Claim one leased job, obtain App access and read the current PR and previous review.

name: Git history and source
description: Fetch immutable Git commits, parse diffs, read trusted rules and chunk tracked source files.

name: Index repository chunks
description: Batch local dense and BM25 embeddings, upsert Qdrant points and verify index completeness.

name: Retrieve and review each diff
description: Explicit semantic, lexical and exact searches, fused evidence, DeepSeek draft and verification.

name: Save review intent
description: Persist verified results before any GitHub writes so retries reuse the same findings.

name: Reconcile and guard publication
description: Read previous bot comments, suppress duplicates and check the current head and lease.

name: Post inline findings
description: Publish a commit-bound review only when it has new findings; recheck the head.

name: Maintain summary and state
description: Maintain the PR summary, retain three revision indexes and save the published head.

name: Recover failed jobs
nodeNames: Retry failed job up to three times
description: Record the failing node and retry the job up to three times.
